description: Defines classes and structures related to buffer slots and their states in Android's graphics buffer management, including BufferState and BufferSlot structures with associated methods and member variables.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Tracks the state of a buffer slot, including counts for dequeue, queue, acquire, and shared status, with methods to modify and query state.

classes.name: BufferSlot
classes.description: Represents a buffer slot with associated buffer, EGL display, fence, and state information, used in buffer management.

methods.name: isFree
methods.description: Checks if the buffer slot is free (not dequeued, queued, or acquired).

methods.name: isDequeued
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been dequeued.

methods.name: isQueued
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is queued.

methods.name: isAcquired
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been acquired.

methods.name: isShared
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is in shared mode.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer state to initial free state.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Increments the dequeue count, marking the buffer as dequeued.

methods.name: detachProducer
methods.description: Decrements the dequeue count, detaching producer ownership.

methods.name: attachProducer
methods.description: Increments the dequeue count, attaching producer ownership.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Moves buffer from dequeued to queued state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the dequeued state, decrementing dequeue count.

methods.name: freeQueued
methods.description: Decrements the queue count, freeing the buffer.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Marks the buffer as acquired, updating counts accordingly.

methods.name: acquireNotInQueue
methods.description: Marks the buffer as acquired without changing queue count.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the acquired buffer, updating counts.

methods.name: detachConsumer
methods.description: Decrements acquire count, detaching consumer ownership.

methods.name: attachConsumer
methods.description: Increments acquire count, attaching consumer ownership.
